explication: Datadog Agent is a host and cluster observability and security product: it collects signals, processes them through specialized agent components, and forwards telemetry to Datadog. A typical workflow begins with host, workload, or application activity; collectors and probes produce metrics, logs, traces, process data, or security events; processing and forwarding components deliver those signals to intake. The tree also shows Kubernetes/cluster coordination, OpenTelemetry support, profiling, and serverless lifecycle features. Several paths are inferred from component names and repository structure; only the log-pipeline and security-rule relationships have direct support in sampled source.
